items.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
items.snippet: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

items.title: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay
items.snippet: Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.

items.title: XRP Ledger is set to fix its lending code before anyone can use it
items.snippet: Validators have a bug-fix patch on course to go live Friday. The lending system it partly repairs is still 10 votes short of approval.
items.note: Позитивний тон для XRP за ключовими словами.

items.title: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
items.snippet: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.

items.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
items.snippet: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC, ETH за ключовими словами.

items.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
items.snippet: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.
